title: Dirichlet eigenvalue asymptotics on conformally compact Einstein manifolds
summary: We study the first Dirichlet eigenvalues of large geodesic balls and fixed-width boundary layers on conformally compact Einstein manifolds of dimension $n+1.$ For large balls, we determine the exponential rate of convergence when the spectral bottom is less than $\frac{n^2}{4},$ i.e. the bottom of the continuous spectrum. When it equals the bottom of the continuous spectrum, the second coefficient has two possible values, according to whether the continued resolvent is regular or has a pole there.
